manifest.name: dsh-ark-plan
manifest.description: Correctly activate DeepSeek v4 flash on the Volcano Ark plan API for DeepSeek Harness: default config injection (ark provider + reasoningEfforts + reasoningEffort=max) plus an ark_plan_doctor self-check tool.

bundle.text:
# dsh-ark-plan — activate DeepSeek v4 flash on the Volcano Ark plan API.
#
# Strategy: reuse pi-ai's BUILT-IN "deepseek" provider (which already knows
# the models: reasoning support incl. effort=max, 1M context, 384K output)
# and only override baseURL to point at Ark's plan API. No separate "ark"
# provider is created — a fresh profile gets exactly the same shape a user
# would hand-write: deepseek route + ark URL + effort=max.
#
# These are DEFAULTS: dsh-settings registers the entry config as the base of
# each settings section, so a user's own settings.yaml always wins over these
# values. A profile that already configures the same keys keeps its own.
- id: llm-pi-ai
  config:
    providers:
      deepseek:
        # Ark plan API is OpenAI-Responses/chat-completions compatible, so the
        # built-in deepseek protocol (openai-completions, deepseek thinking
        # format) works against it as-is — verified live.
        baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3
        # Dedicated key env so the ark route never collides with the official
        # route's DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (sk-...): fill ARK_API_KEY with the ark-...
        # key from the Volcano console. Official route keeps DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
        apiKeyEnv: ARK_API_KEY
        # models intentionally omitted: the installed catalog supplies
        # deepseek-v4-flash / deepseek-v4-pro with reasoningEfforts (max),
        # contextWindow 1000000 and maxTokens 384000.
- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    # deepseek-official = pi-ai's built-in route (api.deepseek.com, official
    # key). Default stays on the official route; the ark route above is the
    # budget lane — switch the model picker to the "deepseek" provider's
    # DeepSeek V4 Flash(ARK) to burn the ark plan tokens instead.
    #
    # If a plugin registers variant providers, point this at its variant here.
    # (An earlier revision named modlens / vision-toolkit as examples; both are
    # retired — DSH 0.2.0 reads images natively — and neither exists in the
    # installed profiles any more, so naming them only misled.)
    provider: deepseek-official
    model: deepseek-v4-flash
    # Effort max rides on the built-in catalog's reasoning support (no manual
    # reasoningEfforts needed on this route) — pi-ai sends
    # thinking.type=enabled + reasoning_effort=max on the completions wire.
    reasoningEffort: max

readme.text:
Activate **DeepSeek v4 flash** on the **Volcano Ark plan API**
(`https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3`) in DeepSeek Harness —
the budget lane: 10× cheaper off-peak token bundles for the same model.

readme.section: Strategy: built-in route + baseURL override (no custom provider)
readme.text:
The plugin reuses **pi-ai's built-in `deepseek` provider** — which already
knows the models (reasoning incl. effort=max, 1M context, 384K output) — and
only overrides `baseURL` to point at Ark's plan API. No hand-rolled "ark"
provider, nothing to re-declare, nothing to silently degrade.

Two lanes coexist:

readme.section: Strategy: built-in route + baseURL override (no custom provider)
readme.text:
| Lane | Provider | baseURL | Key env | Key prefix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Official (default) | `deepseek-official` | api.deepseek.com | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | `sk-...` |
| Ark budget | `deepseek` (DeepSeek V4 Flash(ARK)) | ark plan API | `ARK_API_KEY` | `ark-...` |

readme.section: Strategy: built-in route + baseURL override (no custom provider)
readme.text:
Default model stays on the official route; the ark lane is there to burn the
cheap plan tokens when you want them — switch the model picker to the
`deepseek` provider's models to use it, then switch back when the bundle runs
out (don't buy more: the plan's value ends there).

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: sk-...      # official DeepSeek key (official lane)
ARK_API_KEY: ark-...          # Volcano Ark plan key (ark lane)
```

The two envs are deliberately separate — a `sk-` key against the ark
baseURL answers `401 AuthenticationError` and vice versa.

Ask your agent to run `ark_plan_doctor`. It reads the current config, flags
the known mistakes, and live-tests ark `/chat/completions` with the deepseek
thinking format (`thinking.type=enabled` + `reasoning_effort=max`) — expect
`serverModel` = `deepseek-v4-flash-ga-<date>` (e.g. `...-ga-260731`, the 0731
build) and `thinking: true`.

| Trap | Symptom if missed |
|---|---|
| **Stale standalone `ark` provider** (v0.1 layout) | A duplicate "ark \| 自定义" entry in the Models page with a red dot. Remove `llm-pi-ai.providers.ark`. |
| **`reasoningEffort: max` not set** | Thinking runs at the endpoint default (high), not max. |
| **Wrong key family for the baseURL** | `sk-...` against ark → 401; `ark-...` against api.deepseek.com → 401. Match key to endpoint. |
| **`ARK_API_KEY` missing** | The ark lane exists but answers 401 until its key is filled. |
| **baseURL not the ark plan API** | Plugin defaults do nothing if `deepseek.baseURL` points at `api.deepseek.com` — that's just the official route. |

dsh-settings registers each entry's patch config as the `base` of its settings
section, so plugin defaults only apply where the user has not configured the
same keys. No overwriting of user settings.
